supersedes: v1 used an independent signed validation gap and is diagnostic history, not the manuscript empirical objective
empirical_objective: For each of 101 fixed r values, q0 and nested q1 independently minimise Brier risk on the same D rows. q1 candidates include the fitted q0 lifted with zero held-out coefficients and a zero start. Select minimum nonnegative empirical inf-risk gap; tie1e-12 then min abs r then r.
screen: Independent S clipped gap <=2SE, zero-null nonrejection; not an equivalence certificate.
end_to_end: Survivors receive the same N/E AIPW, common rho and exact largest-component aggregation as the moment hard4 arm.
claim_boundary: restricted linear bounded-probit critic, two development seeds, hard4; neither neural nor confirmatory
